title: Farmslot Command Center recipe workspace smoke
description: Validates the Command Center recipe tab, artifact viewer, replay controls, and ready/review workspace basics with reviewer-visible evidence.

open-ready-workspace-recipe.intent: Open a ready workspace on the Recipe drawer so the stream remains visible while recipe controls render.

assert-replay-controls.intent: Verify replay controls are present in the Recipe panel and default to human-readable 2 second playback.

assert-artifact-viewer.intent: Verify the selected-run evidence section exposes refreshable typed artifacts separately from PR feedback.

assert-recipe-graph.intent: Verify the recipe graph renders workflow nodes from the selected run package.

open-ready-workspace-dev-harness.intent: Open the ready-workspace dev harness to validate the reusable Ready tab recipe panel in isolation.

assert-ready-workspace-recipe-controls.intent: Verify the Ready workspace exposes the shared recipe runner controls and graph without hiding the stream.

open-review-workspace-dev-harness.intent: Open the review-workspace dev harness to validate review workspace basics alongside the recipe fixtures.

assert-review-workspace-basics.intent: Verify the Review workspace renders the reviewer context used beside recipe evidence during ready/review flows.

open-family-publish-gate-harness.intent: Open the family retrospective harness on a historical run that already has a resolved publish-gate decision.

assert-family-runner-sessions.intent: Verify the selected family run remounts runner-session reopen and tmux attach copy controls.

assert-family-reopen-control.intent: Verify a selected historical run with a publish-gate decision offers reopen without requiring a live pending gate.

press-family-reopen.intent: Reopen the persisted publish-gate workspace from family history.

assert-family-ready-workspace.intent: Verify family history remounts the same ready-workspace panel in read-only resolved form.

press-family-maximize.intent: Maximize the remounted publish-gate workspace so the historical review uses the full view.

assert-family-gate-maximized.intent: Verify maximize fills the family view and the control switches to Restore.

capture-family-publish-gate.intent: Record the maximized family publish-gate workspace for review.

press-family-restore.intent: Restore the publish-gate workspace from fullscreen back into the selected-run column.

assert-family-gate-restored.intent: Verify Restore leaves the gate open inline instead of unmounting it.

assert-family-gate-closed.intent: Verify Close unmounts ready-workspace rather than only leaving fullscreen.

select-family-run-without-gate.intent: Select a family run that never reached the publication gate.

assert-family-no-reopen-control.intent: Verify a run without a ready decision does not offer reopen.

open-archived-history-harness.intent: Open the rare History path that renders a recycle snapshot after the live transcript is gone.

text_contains: What did the worker already try?
assert-archived-history.intent: Verify the History tab shows archived source and the snapshot turns instead of an unavailable empty state.

capture-recipe-workspace.intent: Record the Command Center recipe workspace with replay controls, graph, and artifacts visible.

index-artifacts.intent: Publish the Command Center DOM report and CDP log; the screenshot is already registered by its capture action.
